claim.claim-text: 1. A method, comprising: at an electronic device with one or more input devices and a display:

displaying, on the display, a representation of image data, wherein the representation of the image data is a live preview of image data captured within a field of view of one or more cameras displayed in a digital viewfinder; while displaying, on the display, the representation of the image data:

in accordance with a determination that a set of criteria are met, applying a first image filter to the representation of image data; and in accordance with a determination that one or more criterion of the set of criteria are not met:

forgoing applying the first image filter to the representation of image data; and displaying a first graphical indication corresponding to the one or more criterion of the set of criteria, wherein the set of criteria are required in order for the first image filter to be applied to the representation of image data.

2. The method of claim 1, further comprising: in accordance with the determination that the set of criteria are met, forgoing displaying the first graphical indication corresponding to the one or more criterion of the set of criteria.
3. The method of any of claims 1-2, wherein the set of criteria include a criterion that is met when a subject is detected within the field of view of the one or more cameras.
4. The method of any of claims 1-3, wherein the set of criteria include a criterion that is met when a subject is detected within a predetermined distance from the one or more cameras.
5. The method of any of claims 1-4, wherein the set of criteria include a criterion that is met when an amount of light detected by the one or more cameras is above a threshold.

6. The method of any of claims 1-5, wherein the first graphical indication corresponding to the one or more criterion of the set of criteria includes an instruction for one or more actions to take to meet the one or more criterion.
7. The method of any of claims 1-6, wherein the first graphical indication corresponding to one or more criterion of the set of criteria is overlaid on the representation of image data.

8. The method of any of claims 1-7, further comprising: in accordance with a determination that the set of criteria are met, displaying a second graphical indication that indicates that the set of criteria have been met.

9. The method of any of claims 1-8, further comprising: in accordance with the determination that the one or more criterion of the set of criteria are not met, applying a temporary filter different from the first image filter to the representation of the image data.
10. The method of any of claims 1-9, wherein applying the first image filter to the representation of image data includes:

applying the first image filter to a first portion of the representation of image data; and forgoing applying the first image filter to a second portion of the representation of the image data, wherein the second portion of the representation of image data is different from the first portion of the representation of image data.

11. The method of any of claims 1-10, wherein the one or more criterion of the set of criteria includes a first criterion that is not met and a second criterion that is not met, and wherein the first graphical indication corresponds to the first criterion, the method further comprising: after detecting that the first criterion of the set of criteria has been met and in accordance with a determination that the second criterion of the set of criteria is not met: displaying a second graphical indication different from the first graphical indication corresponding to the second criterion.

12. A computer-readable storage medium storing one or more programs configured to be executed by one or more processors of an electronic device with one or more input devices and a display, the one or more programs including instructions for performing the method of any of claims 1-11.
